AI ENGINEERING REQUIREMENTS High proficiency using AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) with a strong understanding of AI-driven and AI-managed coding workflows. Solid grounding in prompt engineering — structuring, iterating, and validating prompts for consistent, production-quality code generation. Hands-on experience designing and constructing AI coding agent customisations: agents, skills, hooks, MCP servers, and plugins. CORE SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS Frontend React / Angular (micro-frontend architecture with single-spa / Module Federation) TypeScript, HTML5, CSS Unit testing: Jasmine, Karma, Jest Backend & Integration Java (Spring Boot / Spring Cloud) — primary backend services Node.js — lightweight APIs and integration services RESTful APIs & microservices architecture KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Design, build, and deliver end-to-end features across React/Angular frontends and Java/Node.js microservices, integrated with REST APIs and Kafka-based event streams. Own prompt structuring, validation, and refinement for AI-generated code — ensuring correctness, security compliance, and adherence to Citizens' engineering standards. Leverage AI coding agents (GitHub Copilot, Claude Code) by authoring customisations — agents, skills, hooks, MCP servers, and plugins — to accelerate development without sacrificing quality. Build multi-agent AI applications using Agent SDKs to orchestrate workflows where agents collaborate or hand off tasks to each other. Implement and champion test-driven development (TDD) across unit, integration, and contract testing layers using Jasmine/Jest/Karma. Contribute to and improve CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions) and cloud-native deployments on AWS/Azure using Docker and Kubernetes (AKS/EKS). Maintain observability standards — structured logging (ELK/Datadog), alerting (Prometheus/Grafana/AppDynamics), and performance profiling. Collaborate with product, design, and architecture teams to translate business goals into scalable, compliant technical solutions. Manage parallel workstreams and evolving requirements, ensuring incremental and continuous value delivery through agile practices. About Siemens Healthineers At Siemens Healthineers, we pioneer breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably. Our purpose is to empower healthcare providers with innovative, reliable, and intelligent technologies that improve patient outcomes and make healthcare more accessible. By combining advanced medical devices, intelligent software, and modern engineering practices, we build solutions that address real-world healthcare challenges while ensuring sustainability and long-term impact. As AI transforms the way software is engineered and experienced, we are looking for AI-Native Software Developers who can leverage AI throughout the software development lifecycle while building secure, scalable, and intelligent healthcare applications. Role Overview As an AI-Native Software Developer, you will design, develop, and maintain high-quality software while effectively leveraging AI to accelerate engineering productivity and enhance software capabilities. You will integrate AI-powered services into applications, validate AI-generated outputs, and apply responsible AI principles to deliver reliable, secure, and scalable healthcare solutions. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative products while continuously adopting emerging AI technologies and modern engineering practices. Key Responsibilities Analyze business and technical requirements and identify opportunities to incorporate AI capabilities where they add value. Design, develop, and maintain secure, scalable, and high-quality software solutions using modern engineering practices. Leverage AI-assisted engineering practices to improve productivity while validating AI-generated code, tests, and documentation. Integrate AI-powered features, services, or intelligent agents into applications using enterprise AI platforms and context engineering principles. Ensure software quality, reliability, and performance through automated testing, continuous delivery, and validation of AI-enabled features. Apply secure coding and responsible AI practices to ensure privacy, compliance, and trustworthy AI solutions. Collaborate across global teams and continuously adopt emerging technologies to drive engineering excellence. Qualifications Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science/Software Engineering/Information Technology, or related discipline. 4-7 years of experience in software development using modern engineering practices. Strong understanding of software architecture, object-oriented design, and design patterns. Experience developing enterprise-scale cloud-native applications. Technical Skills Software Engineering C# , .NET / .NET Core REST APIs, Microservices Angular / React / JavaScript / TypeScript /HTML5 / CSS Cloud & DevOps Microsoft Azure (preferred) Docker / Kubernetes Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines Infrastructure as Code (desirable) AI Engineering Experience integrating AI services or Large Language Models into applications. Familiarity with AI-assisted software development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot or equivalent). Understanding of context engineering principles for enterprise AI applications. Knowledge of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) concepts and AI orchestration frameworks is desirable. Familiarity with AI evaluation, guardrails, and responsible AI practices. Software Quality Test automation TDD / BDD Secure coding Performance optimization Observability and monitoring Behavioral Competencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Growth mindset with passion for continuous learning. Ability to effectively collaborate across global teams. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Ability to balance engineering excellence with rapid innovation. Ownership mindset and commitment to delivering customer value. Preferred Qualifications Experience developing healthcare software or regulated products. Familiarity with medical device software standards and secure software development practices. Exposure to AI agents, workflow automation, or enterprise AI platforms. Contributions to open-source projects or developer communities are an advantage. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent systems that improve user productivity and automate complex workflows. Key Responsibilities AI / Agentic Workflows (Primary Focus) Build and integrate AI-powered features using LLMs and external AI services. Design and implement agentic workflows involving multi-step task execution, tool usage, and state management. Contribute to prompt design, evaluation, and iteration to improve quality and reliability of AI outputs. Implement basic guardrails, monitoring, and fallback mechanisms for production-grade AI systems. Collaborate with product and design teams to identify opportunities for AI-driven automation and user value. Full Stack Development Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end features across frontend and backend systems. Build scalable frontend applications using React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript. Develop backend services and APIs to support application and AI workflows. Ensure performance, reliability, and maintainability of systems. System Design & Collaboration Participate in low-to-mid complexity system design discussions. Break down ambiguous requirements into clear technical tasks and deliverables. Collaborate effectively with product managers, designers, and QA. Contribute to code reviews and uphold engineering best practices. Tooling & Engineering Excellence Work within monorepos using Bazel and Rush. Use Git for version control and code reviews. Track work and execution using Jira in Agile environments. Contribute to CI/CD pipelines, testing, and release processes. Required Qualifications 4–6 years of experience in software engineering. Strong proficiency in TypeScript, JavaScript, Lit or other web component frameworks (React is a plus). Experience building full stack applications (frontend + backend). Hands-on experience integrating AI/LLM APIs into applications. Hands-on experience with multistage LLM pipelines – writing, debugging, and iterating system prompts for structured JSON output from models. Familiarity with REST APIs, asynchronous systems, and distributed services. Experience with Git-based workflows and Agile development using Jira. Strong debugging, problem-solving, and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications Knowledge of backend frameworks (e.g., Node.js, Express, or similar). Familiarity with Bazel and Rush in large-scale codebases. Experience with observability, logging, and monitoring for production systems. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and automated testing. Demonstrates good judgment in using AI capabilities effectively. Actively contributes to team velocity and code quality. Begins to mentor junior engineers and influence best practices. Job Purpose and Impact The Software Engineer – Ag & Trade will design, develop, and maintain scalable, high quality software applications that support Cargill's Ag & Trade business. The ideal candidate is a hands-on full-stack engineer with strong Python backend expertise, React/React Native frontend experience, and a passion for building modern, AI-enabled applications. This role partners closely with Product Managers, Architects, UX Designers, and fellow Engineers to deliver secure, reliable, and performant software solutions. The engineer will leverage modern development practices, AI-assisted development tools, and cloud-native technologies to accelerate delivery while maintaining high engineering standards. The role also participates actively in code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement initiatives. Key Accountabilities SOFTWARE DEVELOPMENT Design, develop, test, and maintain scalable software applications using Python for backend services and React/React Native for frontend development. Write clean, maintainable, reusable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices. FULL-STACK APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT Build and enhance end-to-end web and mobile applications by developingRESTful APIs, backend services, frontend components, and database integrations while ensuring seamless user experiences. AI-ENABLED ENGINEERING Utilize AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude, or similar tools to improve developer productivity. Experience integrating LLM APIs or AI capabilities into applications is highly desirable. COLLABORATION Collaborate with Product Managers, Business Analysts, UX Designers, Architects, QA Engineers, and cross-functional engineering teams to understand requirements, estimate work, and deliver high-quality software aligned with business objectives. TESTING & QUALITY Develop unit tests, integration tests, and participate in code reviews to ensure high code quality, reliability, maintainability, and application performance. CLOUD & DEVOPS (Preferred) Contribute to configuration of CI/CD pipelines, containerized deployments, and cloud native application development using technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, or AWS. CONTINUOUS IMPROVEMENT Identify opportunities to improve development practices, software architecture, engineering standards, and automation. Adopt modern engineering practices and AI assisted workflows to enhance team productivity. TECHNICAL SUPPORT Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis, and provide timely resolutions while ensuring application stability and availability. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 3–5 years of professional software development experience. Minimum 3 years of hands-on Python development experience. Experience developing production-grade applications using React or React Native. Strong understanding of object-oriented programming, data structures, algorithms, and software design principles. Experience developing REST APIs and microservices. Strong knowledge of Git, SQL, and modern software development practices. Experience working in Agile/Scrum development teams.
